About Us

Knowledge, character and confidence — together

Founded in 1998, Government Senior Secondary School Jharsaintly has been committed to quality education for over 27 years. Our focus goes beyond exam results, centering on the all-round development of every student.

Through a team of experienced teachers, modern classrooms and a wide range of co-curricular activities, we prepare students for every stage of life ahead.

Our vision is to nurture responsible, confident and skilled citizens who contribute meaningfully to society. We believe every child deserves individual attention, a safe and disciplined environment, and real opportunities to discover their potential — academically, physically and creatively.

From well-equipped science and computer laboratories to a vibrant sports program, an active library and regular cultural and academic competitions, our campus is designed to make learning an everyday adventure. Generations of our alumni have gone on to excel in engineering, medicine, civil services, sports and the arts — a reflection of the strong foundation built here.

Academic Streams

Stream options for grades 11–12

Each stream is guided by experienced, subject-specialist teachers.

Science Stream

Science Stream

PCM/PCB groups preparing students for engineering, medicine and research careers.

  • Physics, Chemistry, Math/Biology
  • Modern laboratories
  • JEE/NEET guidance
Commerce Stream

Commerce Stream

Theoretical and practical knowledge in business, economics and accounting.

  • Accountancy & Business Studies
  • Economics & Mathematics
  • CA/CS foundation guidance
Humanities Stream

Humanities Stream

In-depth study opportunities in history, political science and languages.

  • History, Geography, Political Science
  • Psychology as an elective
  • Civil services preparatory guidance
